title: mut.manual
mutation_directive: extend beyond 2 onion shells — add 4-6 concentric layers at varying radii, each layer with slightly different rotation speed and opacity. Improve color: shift from current palette to iridescent pearlescent — layers range from deep sapphire inner (#0a1a3a) to pale silver outer (#d0d8e0) with subtle aurora-green mid-layer (#203820). Make each shell feel distinct, not just scaled copies.
